Mr. Manan Malik, Adv. Mr. Durgesh Ramchandra Gupta, AOR UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R 1.

This batch of Special Leave Petitions are against the judgment of the High Court of Punjab and Haryana by which Section 101A inserted by the State legislature in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 was held to be unconstitutional.

sentences.text: 2. We are informed that State of Haryana has also filed an SLP which has not been listed today.
We direct that the SLP filed by the State shall be the lead matter.
Learned standing counsel for the State of Haryana shall provide number of the SLP.
3. We also implead Union of India as a party-respondent.
Let notice be issued to the Union of India.
In the meanwhile, counter and rejoinder affidavits may be exchanged and written submissions shall also be filed.

(INDU MARWAH) (NIDHI WASON) AR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
